title: Austin Housing: Affordable Housing Funding Stalls
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) board convened to consider items related to local housing initiatives.
*   A decision to appoint new directors to the Austin Inner City Redevelopment Corporation (AICRC), which oversees a low-income housing tax credit project, was indefinitely postponed.
*   Plans to approve a substantial loan of over $750,000 for land acquisition and development of the Grove Place Apartments by Youth and Family Alliance (LifeWorks) were also indefinitely delayed.
*   This means key decisions impacting the governance of affordable housing projects and a major housing development were put on hold.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
THURSDAY, JUNE 14,2001
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened
at 3:34 p.m. on Thursday, June 14,2001 in the Hancock Building Board Room at the Lower
Colorado River Authority, 3700 Lake Austin Blvd. The following agenda were the AHFC
items considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
May 24,2001.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
May 24, 2001 were approved on Board Member Alvarez' motion, Board Member
Slasher's second by a 5-0 vote. President Watson and Board Member Wynn were off
the dais.
2. 
Approve a Resolution to appoint Betty Dunkerley, L. Matthew Powell and Roger Arriaga
to the Board of Directors of the Austin Inner City Redevelopment Corporation (AICRC), a
204(c) 4 corporation that oversees the SCIP I Heritage Heights Low-Income Housing Tax
Credit Project.
This item was postponed indefinitely.
3. 
Approve a Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a Rental Housing
Development Assistance (RHDA) Program loan in an amount not to exceed $753,931 to
Youth and Family Alliance, Inc., DBA LifeWorks, or affiliated entity, for land acquisition
and development of the Grove Place Apartments located at 1881 Grove Boulevard.
This item was postponed indefinitely.
The motion to adjourn the board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation at
p.m. was approved on Board Member Thomas' motion, Board Member Slusher's second by
a 6-0 vote. President Watson and Board Member Wynn were off the dais.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of June
14, 2001 were approved on Board Member Wynn's motion, Board Member Griffith's
second by a 6-0 vote. Board Member Thomas was absent.
